_doc: Screen frame provenance and byte guards for multi-OBJ title placement. The guard covers the asset literal consumers (0xB40000-0xB60000), the shared OBJ loader 0xB0FFE4 with its helpers/literals (0xB0FF60-0xB10030), the decompressor dispatch table 0xD8263C, the BIOS SWI stubs 0xB7A85C-0xB7A88C and the bx-r2 veneer 0xB7BD18. Runtime OAM placement is not statically bounded (OAM is built through IWRAM/function-pointer paths), so a guard match is only provisional: the final QA (qa_obj_title_cells.py) requires a candidate_proofs entry captured on the exact candidate ROM (fresh screen capture, see tools/qa_screen_obj_contiguity.py). See docs/research.md.
